messages:
infra-bot: Incident detected: multiple nodes in infer-pool-az1 transitioned to NotReady within ~90s. Auto-page to oncall.
maria: saw the page, jumping on it. any customer-facing alerts yet? :eyes:
josh: getting alerts too, prometheus shows kube_node_status_condition{condition=\"Ready\"} dropping on 3 nodes in az1.
deepa: logs from node-az1-12 show repeated kubelet crashloop, last lines look like `fatal error: runtime: out of memory` then `kubelet: panic`.
infra-bot: Autoscaling fallback triggered: routing policy shifted ~40% traffic to infer-reserve-usw to maintain latency SLOs.
sam: adding context — we had a batch of heavy long-sequence inferences around the time (seq_len ~4096) on those pods, could be memory blowouts.
maria: ok first things first: cordon node-az1-12/13/14 to stop new pods, and drain non-critical pods. can someone run `kubectl cordon` and `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`?
josh: running cordon/drain now. attaching command output:
```
$ kubectl cordon node-az1-12
node/node-az1-12 cordoned
$ kubectl drain node-az1-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
evicting pod inference-worker-xyz...
pod evicted
```
deepa: I've started a rolling restart of kubelet on node-az1-12 to see if it stabilizes: `systemctl restart kubelet` — watching logs: `kubelet[1234]: E0831 12:04:01 eviction manager: failed to reclaim memory` then `kernel: Out of memory: kill process 2345 (python)`. not great.
infra-bot: Noted. GPU driver logs from node-az1-13 show `NVRM: GPU reset: GPU has fallen off the bus` before kubelet exit.
maria: these are definitely hardware/OOM-adjacent. mitigation path: 1) keep nodes cordoned; 2) scale up spare pool (infer-reserve-usw) by +3; 3) route traffic away from az1; 4) collect heap/dmesg/logs and open infra ticket for node replacement.
sam: scaling infer-reserve-usw +3 now via autoscale API. ETA ~45s for new nodes to register.
josh: traffic shift done via routing policy: set weight(az1)=0.2, weight(usw)=0.8. Confirmed on router: `routes: infer-pool -> [az1:20%,usw:80%]`.
deepa: capturing dmesg + kubelet journal and uploading to /tmp/incident-3467890123-logs.tar.gz, pushing to s3://redwood-incidents/3467890123/.
maria: good. @pager can you own customer communications? we need to assess impact window and update status page.
pager: on it. initial impact: 5% of production requests experienced retries/timeouts between 12:03-12:09 UTC. we'll post a brief status update: "Investigating degraded traffic to inference in us-west-az1; mitigations underway." :writing_hand:
infra-bot: Observability note: p99 latency in az1 spiked to 4.2s, overall p99 increased to 1.1s during window. Error budget burn ~0.8%.
sam: new nodes are up and joining cluster, kubelet healthy on those. infra flagged node-az1-13 for replacement and marked it `unschedulable`.
josh: trying a controlled kubelet log rotation + restart on node-az1-14; if restart fails we should reprovision. tail of journal:
```
Aug 31 12:05:01 kubelet[5678]: runtime: out of memory
Aug 31 12:05:02 kernel: oom_kill invoked for pid 7890 (python)
Aug 31 12:05:03 kubelet[5678]: kubelet panic: runtime error
```
maria: timeline update for customers: impact window 12:03-12:09 UTC, majority handled by reserve pool, small % saw retries. we'll keep customers updated every 30m until fully closed.
deepa: I'm collecting heap profiles from failed pods (if any persisted) and core dumps from nodes where possible. note: pods with local-ephemeral caches may have lost cached KV entries, plan to warm caches back.
infra-bot: reminder: for on-call handoff, please add `#oncall-hand-off` with summary before end of shift.
sam: replacing node-az1-13 now (reprovisioning image + driver reinstall). ETA ~12m.
josh: after drain we observed several pods rescheduled to new nodes and started fine. verifying inference quality tests — first 20 samples passed.
maria: mitigation checklist complete: cordon/drain done for affected nodes, routing policy adjusted, reserve pool scaled, nodes replaced or flagged. next steps: root cause analysis — OOM vs GPU reset? deepa, infra please coordinate.
deepa: will add kernel oops, nvidia logs, and recent job traces to the incident doc. preliminary hypothesis: memory pressure from unexpectedly long sequences combined with a node-level memory leak + occasional GPU bus resets.
pager: status page updated. customer comm: "We mitigated an availability issue impacting a small fraction of inference requests in us-west-az1. Traffic rerouted and nodes replaced; no data loss; continued monitoring." will send more if RCA changes.
infra-bot: Incident severity remains P2. please prepare handoff notes.
maria: adding handoff notes now:
- incident id: 3467890123
- start: 12:02 UTC (alerts)
- impact: ~5% requests retried/timeouts, p99 spike
- actions: cordon/drain nodes, scale reserve pool +3, routing policy changed, nodes replaced
- next: RCA triage with infra + runtime tomorrow 09:00 PST
josh: tagging runtime infra leads and cc'ing ops: @deepa @sam
sam: I'll follow up on driver reinstall logs and hardware health for the three nodes.
maria: thanks everyone. final: leaving incident open until RCA task created. handing off to night oncall. @pager will keep watch.
pager: acknowledged, will take over monitoring and post updates if anything changes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:"
